PM Modi Announces Plans for New Semiconductor Plants

On the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced plans to establish 5-8 more semiconductor plants within the next 7-8 years. This initiative is part of a broader roadmap for the country's development by 2047, which also includes advancements in nuclear power and energy independence. The announcement was made during his Independence Day address.
